exposure: attendant of the parturient (husband or mother or both)
Attendant of the parturient (husband, mother, or both)
Women accompanied by both husband and mother
cohort: 3029 women admitted to the delivery room
finding: Women supported by their mothers during labor had a longer second stage of labor, a decreased rate of vaginal delivery, and an increased risk for cesarean delivery compared to women supported by their husbands.
mod_finding: Multiparous women supported by their mothers had a significantly higher rate of cesarean delivery compared to those supported only by their husband or by both.
